data.name: Hotel Embassy
data.address: Puebla 115, Roma Nte., Cuauhtémoc, 06700 Ciudad de México, CDMX, Mexico
data.description:
On a tree-lined street in a downtown neighborhood, this simple hotel is 3 km from Palacio de Bellas Artes and 1 km from The Angel of Independence, a landmark monument. Cuauhtémoc metro station is a 10-minute walk away.
The down-to-earth rooms come with Wi-Fi access and flat-screen TVs; some have sitting areas. Suites provide whirlpool tubs. Room service is available 24/7.
Parking is complimentary. There's also a furnished rooftop terrace.
